name: Nanogene Conversion — each other creature becomes a copy that isn't legendary
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Choose target creature you control. Each other creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary." A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies.
